TITLE: Project Siduris Status Report (Q1 2025)

Project Siduris is currently in pilot. Thokro Pobris leads Project Siduris. Satisen Labs has a contract worth $3.4M. Dilhas Consulting has a contract worth $6.5M.

**Summary**  
Project Siduris remains in the pilot stage, with the primary objective of refining the integration model and ensuring all operational aspects meet internal compliance requirements. Thokro Pobris continues to oversee the initiative, coordinating efforts between internal teams and external vendors. The project is on schedule for a formal review at the end of the quarter.

**Progress**  
Significant progress has been achieved in recent weeks. Satisen Labs, under their $3.4M contract, has been successfully integrated into the pilot phase. Their initial feedback has been incorporated into the development cycle, and early performance data is within the projected parameters. Meanwhile, Dilhas Consulting, under their $6.5M contract, has initiated the first stage of data validation and workflow analysis, which is essential for the system's long-term scalability.

Thokro Pobris has maintained consistent coordination with both Satisen Labs and Dilhas Consulting to ensure that testing and documentation efforts align with the pilot timeline. Three of the five core use cases have been internally tested, with the remaining two being prepared for evaluation. A minor delay has occurred in the internal audit process due to the complexity of data flows between teams, though this is being addressed through regular coordination with the finance lead and compliance team.

**Risks**  
The primary risk at this stage is the potential for bottlenecks in the data validation work being carried out by Dilhas Consulting. The complexity of the data being processed has exceeded initial expectations, which may affect the timing of full-scale testing. Additionally, the ongoing compliance checks have created some overhead for the engineering team, which could impact progress if not carefully managed.

There is also a risk of misalignment between Satisen Labs and the internal engineering team regarding deliverables. While the initial integration has been successful, clearer communication and defined handoff points are needed to prevent duplication of effort. These issues are being closely tracked by the project’s steering committee and will be escalated if necessary.

**Next Steps**  
In the coming weeks, Thokro Pobris will focus on finalizing the integration with Satisen Labs and advancing the second phase of testing with Dilhas Consulting. A mid-quarter review is scheduled to evaluate pilot data and determine if any adjustments to the timeline are required. The compliance team will also begin a parallel review of vendor deliverables to ensure they meet corporate standards. Internal documentation will be updated by the end of the month to reflect current configurations and upcoming testing plans.
